headings: Finding a Treatment for Opium Addiction

blocks.text: Opium addiction usually takes place when one is addicted or has become dependent to the drug. Opium is one of the illegal drugs which are distributed and used not only in Canada but in many different parts of the world as well. For those that distribute opium, many of them would prefer refining the drug into heroin which is something more of a value compared to plain opium. In short, heroin is more profitable and a much stronger form of drug because it contains the principal psychoactive substance of opium called morphine.

As time progresses, addiction to opium usually happens and this simply entails the development of tolerance of a person taking the drug. In fact, more and more opium is needed so as to get the euphoric effect which is commonly sought by many users. A large number of persons using opium usually experience withdrawal symptoms after years of using the drug.

blocks.text: Opium has other street names which include Dopium, Dream Stick and Dream Gun. The dried form is usually smoked while others tend to eat it. The real nature of this drug is simply high when it comes to its addictive property, thereby creating a sense of dependency over time on the part of the user. This means that the user wants more of the drug so as to satisfy his cravings.

When opium is used initially, the person who takes it usually experiences a sense of euphoria, wellbeing and extreme calmness. Any problem that he may have will prove to be meaningless to him and nothing else matters except to the reality that opium really works at his end. However, as the effects of the drug wear off, the person usually experiences hallucinations and nightmares.

blocks.text: Stopping the intake of a particular after using it for a long period of time usually causes withdrawal symptoms, as experienced in other types of drugs. Withdrawal symptoms that are related to opium addiction commonly include but not limited to the following: insomnia, mood swings, anxiety, depression, muscle spasm, loss of appetite, vomiting, diarrhea, cramps, sweating and nausea.

What is Opium ?

Opium addiction usually takes place when one is addicted or has become dependent to the drug. Opium is one of the illegal drugs which are distributed and used not only in Canada but in many different parts of the world as well. For those that distribute opium, many of them would prefer refining the drug into heroin which is something more of a value compared to plain opium. In short, heroin is more profitable and a much stronger form of drug because it contains the principal psychoactive substance of opium called morphine.

Opium Description

As time progresses, addiction to opium usually happens and this simply entails the development of tolerance of a person taking the drug. In fact, more and more opium is needed so as to get the euphoric effect which is commonly sought by many users. A large number of persons using opium usually experience withdrawal symptoms after years of using the drug.

Opium has other street names which include Dopium, Dream Stick and Dream Gun. The dried form is usually smoked while others tend to eat it. The real nature of this drug is simply high when it comes to its addictive property, thereby creating a sense of dependency over time on the part of the user. This means that the user wants more of the drug so as to satisfy his cravings.

Withdrawal symptoms that are related to opium addiction commonly include but not limited to the following: insomnia, mood swings, anxiety, depression, muscle spasm, loss of appetite, vomiting, diarrhea, cramps, sweating and nausea.
